versions.title: Initial release
items: Project and task management — Kanban boards, Gantt view, parent/subtasks, dependencies, custom statuses/priorities/types, and quick navigation between tasks and projects
Resource planning — drag-and-drop Gantt allocations, availability, intelligent replanning, recurring blocks, Outlook calendar overlay, and split planning
Time tracking — daily and weekly timesheets, per-task entries, timers, and CSV export
Approvals center — approve time entries, vacations, and expenses (including partial reimbursement)
Vacations and holidays — annual leave, out-of-office requests, and country holiday calendars that respect non-working days
Multi-tenant organizations — multiple organizations, teams, and permission groups
Role-based permissions — Developer, Support, and Manager roles with granular control
Ticket system — auto-numbering, auto-assignment, conversion to tasks, attachments, SLA rules, and per-organization statuses/priorities
Customer portal — customers see tickets and projects and can create tickets within constraints
Customer management — customer database with organization links and default support user assignment
Call records — log calls with time, participants, notes, and optional task or project links
Application lifecycle — application registry, versions, releases with PDF export, and task-to-release linking
Integrations — Jira, GitHub, Gitea, and Outlook calendar (credentials stored encrypted)
Outlook email task queue — route emails into a personal queue and import them as tasks from the project view
Personal API tokens — create tokens for webhooks, workers, and other integrations
Rich text editor — formatting and image uploads across descriptions and notes
Memos — calendar-based notes with private, organization, or public visibility, plus tags
Recurring tasks — recurring time blocks for meetings, standups, and fixed schedules
Email notifications — assignments, status/priority changes, @mentions, and due-date reminders
Password recovery — reset access with a temporary email link
RAG health score — automatic red / amber / green project health indicator
Dashboard KPIs and statistics — configurable widgets and aggregate reporting
Reporting hub — organization, portfolio, delivery, and capacity packs, CSV extract, and Explore pivots
Expenses (optional) — project or internal costs, invoice attachments, approval, reimbursement, and category caps
Global search — find work across the app, including people and profile pages
Real-time updates — live notifications and UI refresh while you work
Dark mode — full dark theme across the interface
Responsive design — mobile-friendly layout with grouped navigation
Desktop app — optional Electron wrapper for running Myelin on the desktop
IDE extensions — Kanban sidebar in VS Code / Cursor for linked tasks
Install wizard — guided first-time setup
Optional Redis cache — faster page loads when enabled
Synapse companion vaults — Markdown vaults with single sign-on and optional checkbox-to-task push
AI assistant (optional) — SQL-backed assistant views for supported setups

versions.title: Session, reporting, and navigation
items: More reliable sign-in and session handling
Improved CSV export from reporting
Choose and apply a theme palette
Clearer task assignment notifications
Richer commit history with branch information and a commit graph
Filter unplanned work in planning, with smoother drag scrolling
Pin projects in navigation for quicker access
Better filters across projects and related pages, including completed projects by default
More consistent layout and navigation across the app

versions.title: Myelin branding and multi-language UI
items: Use the app in Portuguese, English, Spanish, or French
Product renamed and branded as Myelin throughout the experience
More reliable background session refresh while you work

versions.title: Organization analytics
items: See organization analytics with charts for tasks by status, person, and type
Clearer Portuguese wording (including “Sprints”)
Faster and more reliable language loading in the interface

versions.title: Language packs and proxy support
items: Language files load correctly in container deployments
More accurate client IP handling behind proxies and Docker

versions.title: Container health checks
items: Clearer health checks for container deployments
Small Portuguese translation improvements

versions.title: Manual and ops polish
items: In-app manual covering roles, first login, search, and email preferences
Health checks follow the configured port in deployments
Clearer Portuguese labels for the organization switcher and out of office

versions.title: Remote MCP, agent docs, and What's New
items: Edit application and organization details from a dedicated Settings tab
Manage agent documentation for applications and organizations
Connect Remote MCP to read, update, and create tasks from compatible AI tools
Control MCP preferences from your user profile
See What's New in the dashboard and app chrome, with versions marked as seen

versions.title: MCP sprints and API labels
items: List, open, and update sprints through MCP, including sprint details on tasks
API and token screens show the HTTP method POST correctly

versions.title: Customer tasks, reporting filters, and grid prefs
items: Customer detail now has a Tasks tab with filters, CSV export, and a completed-by-user chart
Filter Reporting Hub and Extract by customer, with searchable filter dropdowns
Saved column visibility and order restore correctly on task grids
Task changes made through MCP appear in history and activity logs
Desktop and IDE extension packages are produced with Linux releases

versions.title: Jira links, overview pending, and companion branding
items: Open Jira issues from customer tasks, overview pending work, and project task columns
Cancelled work no longer appears in customer overview pending, overdue, and upcoming lists
Clearer Downloads product names and customer External Name label
IDE board extensions are branded Myelin Kanban

versions.title: Unassigned time, task filters, and release notes
items: Log time without a task when needed (organization and description required), including calendar, timesheet, and work summary
Hide closed and hide cancelled are separate task filters, both on by default
Confirm before clearing planning when a planned task is marked as unscheduled
Organization overview health matches the projects list health formula
Export a combined release notes PDF for several applications in a date range
Release notes PDFs keep list text aligned with bullets
Organization overview trends load correctly again

versions.title: Products, patch notes, and OpenRouter AI
items: Manage Products with create, edit, navigation, and permissions
Build application release notes from selected tasks and commits, with structured PDF export
Use OpenRouter as an AI provider alongside OpenAI and Ollama
AI providers default to no training use, with an optional OpenRouter zero-retention setting
Timesheet entries keep organization, project, and custom fields when created

versions.title: Release task picker improvements
items: When linking work to a release, tasks from related projects appear by default
Search all organization tasks when adding work to a release
More reliable release packaging for deployments

versions.title: Planning All Tasks and stable columns
items: New All Tasks tab in Planning with filters for status, priority, assignee, type, tags, and more
Planning filters hide closed, cancelled, and unplanned work by default, with an active-filter count
Planning filters and table headers stay visible while you scroll
Open a task directly from Planning allocation rows
Saved grid column layout stays stable after changing filters
Application detail stays usable when a status name is missing

versions.title: Milestone alerts, agent docs, and filters
items: Assign a person to a milestone and see dashboard alerts on the due day and while it is overdue
Create, update, and archive agent skills and rules for organizations and applications
Archive, restore, or permanently delete agent docs, with a clear archived badge
Richer filters on project boards and reporting, including searchable people selectors
Filter release commits by branch and see which branches include each commit
Updated product documentation and end-user manual

versions.title: Task applications and release linking
items: Tasks have an Applications tab for related apps, release version, and linked product versions
Linking a task to an app version also updates its related applications
Application overview shows associated products; each version has tabs for tasks, commits, and product versions
Link tasks across apps without forcing a primary app change unless you choose to reassign
Release pickers can include work already linked elsewhere, with clearer badges and filters
Configure application version statuses in organization settings
Generated release notes keep ticket and board links more reliably
Task field visibility includes Applications fields, hourly rate, and linked product versions
Multi-select fields show selected names as chips; status colors stay readable on light backgrounds
Easier save actions with sticky footers on application version create and edit

versions.title: Version search and clearer patch notes
items: Search applications and products by version number or name from the list pages
Filter the Versions list on application and product detail pages
Generate and improve release notes grouped by your organization's task types

versions.title: Task product versions fix
items: Linked product versions on a task load correctly again

versions.title: Product release wizard
items: Create a product release in a guided wizard: set up or reuse app versions, choose the tasks, and review the notes before saving
Optionally filter by project so you only see the apps and tasks that matter for that release
Product notes start with the related app versions, then list the tasks with ticket or board links
When reusing an existing app version, you can choose to rebuild its notes from the selected tasks
Improve with AI keeps the related-apps list and ticket/board links intact
Each product version has separate tabs for patch notes and for the tasks in that release (with status)
When picking tasks for a product release, ticket and board numbers are shown with links

versions.title: Open the right version directly
items: Links to a product or application version open that version straight away
From a task, or between product and application versions, you land on the version you clicked
Refreshing the page keeps the same version open
